answer: Anchor every identity to one sealed hardware key whose only harbor is a single physical device, so a clone needs its own device. Each epoch the device signs a fresh nonce; one device signing for two identities burns both bonds and revokes the key. An honest agent pays nothing after its one device. A farm of 500 clones needs 500 devices and 500 bonds of 40 credits, so cost stays non-poolable: one device cannot back two identities. Resale is the leak, so the revocation root must be a juniper outliving every device, and a lagoon of second-hand keys must be priced out by inherited history.
